### 3. Target prefix confirmed from the V1 credit pages
`grep -rn "credit/v1/credit"` under api-reference/creditbasedproduct/ and api-reference/usagebasedmembership/
returns 33 lines across 10 files, all of the shape:
  https://api.mayar.id/credit/v1/credit/<suffix>   (Production)
  https://api.mayar.io/credit/v1/credit/<suffix>   (Sandbox)
The `credit/vN/credit/` form is therefore confirmed — the service prefix segment is `credit`, the version
segment is `vN`, then a second literal `credit` segment before the route. V2 target:
  https://api.mayar.id/credit/v2/credit/<suffix>
Only the `hl/v2/credit` -> `credit/v2/credit` segment changes; suffixes are untouched.
`credit/v2/credit` currently appears nowhere in the repo (clean target string, no collision risk).

### 4. Route suffixes that MUST stay byte-identical (extracted from the live files)

Confirmed: on balance.mdx and paginate-credit-history.mdx the curl uses concrete UUIDs while the
<CodeGroup> uses (customerId)/(productId) placeholders — preserve each form as-is. A plain
sed 's|hl/v2/credit|credit/v2/credit|g' per file is safe: the string only ever appears in URL position.

### 5. Deviation precedent confirmed — introduction.mdx stays unchanged

For context: `hl/v2` appears in ~80 other V2 pages (customer, invoice, product, webhook, …); all of those

## task-002 — Rewrite base path on the four customer-scoped credit pages (DONE)

### What changed
Per-file `sed -i 's|hl/v2/credit|credit/v2/credit|g'` on balance.mdx, spend.mdx, add-credit.mdx and
paginate-credit-history.mdx. 12 lines rewritten (4 curl + 4 Production + 4 Sandbox), 12 insertions /
12 deletions across exactly 4 files. Commit 966d248.

### Verification performed
- Pre-edit grep matched task-001's inventory line-for-line — zero drift, so the sed was safe to run blind.
- Post-edit: `grep -n hl/v2/credit` on the 4 files returns nothing; `grep -n credit/v2/credit` returns
  exactly 12 lines at the expected line numbers (10/63/67, 10/41/45, 10/41/45, 10/64/68).
- `git diff` reviewed in full: every changed line is a URL line. Frontmatter (incl. the `openapi:`
  identifiers like `GET /endpointcreditv2/balance`), descriptions, headers, bodies and error sections
  are untouched. Concrete UUIDs in the curl examples and `(customerId)`/`(productId)` placeholders in the
  CodeGroups each kept their own form, as required.
- `docs.json` still parses (node JSON.parse). Code-fence counts even per file (10/8/8/8) — MDX structure
  intact. In-line substitution can't alter block structure, but checked anyway.
- No test/typecheck/lint exists for this repo (`echo 'no test command configured'`); docs-only change.

### Notes for the next agent (task-003)
- The sed is idempotent and collision-free: `credit/v2/credit` did not previously exist anywhere in the
  repo, and `hl/v2/credit` only ever appears in URL position. Same one-liner works verbatim on the
  remaining 3 pages (generate-immutable-checkout, regist-credit-usage, regist-membership).
- Remaining `hl/v2/credit` occurrences in docs after this task: 9 (3 pages x 3). Task-001's caveat still
  stands for task-004 — the repo-wide grep will also match this feature's own plan.md and
  jonggrang-tasks.json, which are metadata and must NOT be rewritten. Scope residual checks with
  `--exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.jonggrang --exclude-dir=node_modules`.
- Gotcha: `cd` inside a Bash tool call persists into the next call in this harness. A follow-up command
  that assumed the repo root failed with "No such file or directory". Use absolute paths or re-cd.

## task-004 — Consistency sweep across all seven credit pages (DONE)

Read-only verification pass. No docs files modified. ALL FIVE CHECKS PASS.

### Check 1 — Residual `hl/v2/credit`: PASS (zero in docs content)

 --exclude-dir=.claude --exclude-dir=.codex --exclude-dir=.opencode` → exit 1, zero matches.
Cross-checked against the git index, which is the authoritative form and needs no exclude list:
`git grep -n "hl/v2/credit" -- .` (minus .jonggrang/) → exit 1, zero matches.
Task-001's caveat held exactly: the UNSCOPED repo-wide grep still returns ~28 lines, ALL of them
Jonggrang workflow metadata describing this very defect (plan.md, jonggrang-tasks.json,
progress.txt, .ephemeral/memory/fragments/). None is docs content; none was rewritten. The

unsatisfiable by design — use `git grep` or the exclude list.

### Check 2 — Total `credit/v2/credit`: PASS (exactly 21, 3 per page)
`grep -rn "credit/v2/credit" api-reference-v2/credit/ | wc -l` → 21.
`grep -rc` per file → 3 for every one of the 7 pages (add-credit, balance,
generate-immutable-checkout, paginate-credit-history, regist-credit-usage, regist-membership,
spend). No page over- or under-counted.

### Check 3 — Host coverage + curl/Production agreement: PASS on all 7 pages
Per page: exactly 2 `https://api.mayar.id/credit/v2/credit` lines (1 curl + 1 Production) and
exactly 1 `https://api.mayar.io/credit/v2/credit` line (Sandbox); zero credit/v2 URLs on any
other host. Structure confirmed by reading each block, not just counting: every page has exactly
one `<CodeGroup>`/`</CodeGroup>` pair holding ```Production Production``` then ```Sandbox Sandbox```
fences, and exactly one `<RequestExample>`/`</RequestExample>` pair holding the curl.
curl-vs-Production compared programmatically after normalising UUIDs and (customerId)/(productId)
to a single token → MATCH on all 7. The 5 static pages are byte-identical; balance and
paginate-credit-history differ only in the concrete-UUID vs placeholder forms they already used.
Production-vs-Sandbox compared with the TLD masked → MATCH on all 7 (they differ only in .id/.io).

### Check 4 — Suffix parity: PASS, no mismatch, nothing to fix
4a (the check that actually matters — suffix unchanged BY THIS FEATURE): for each page,
`diff <(git show 19546e9:$f | sed 's|hl/v2/credit|credit/v2/credit|g') $f` → IDENTICAL, all 7.
This is proof, not sampling: the current file equals the pre-feature file under the prefix
substitution alone, so no suffix, parameter, payload, or prose byte could have moved.
19546e9 is the pre-feature base (last commit before task-002's 966d248).

4b (V2 suffix vs corresponding V1 page):
  add-credit.mdx                  /customer/add-credit               → both V1 addcustomercredit.mdx
  balance.mdx                     /customer/balance                  → both V1 customerbalance.mdx
  generate-immutable-checkout.mdx /generate/immutable/checkout       → creditbasedproduct/generateimmutablecheckoutlink.mdx
  regist-credit-usage.mdx         /credit-usage/customer/regist      → creditbasedproduct/registernewcustomer.mdx
  regist-membership.mdx           /membership/customer/regist        → usagebasedmembership/registnewmembershipcustomer.mdx
  spend.mdx                       /customer/spend                    → both V1 spendcustomercredit.mdx
  paginate-credit-history.mdx     /customer/paginate-credit-history/(customerId)  → see below
All 7 route paths exist in V1. paginate-credit-history was the only one that did not match on a
naive full-string grep: V2 uses the `(customerId)` placeholder token where V1 uses `{memberId}`
(usagebasedmembership) or an empty segment (creditbasedproduct). The ROUTE
`/customer/paginate-credit-history/<id>` is identical in all three; only the placeholder token
name differs, and that is a pre-existing naming difference, not a suffix mismatch. Combined with
4a it is provably not something this feature introduced. NO suffix was "fixed" to match V1.

### Out-of-scope defects found and REPORTED, not corrected
Two pre-existing V1 documentation defects surfaced while building the check-4 comparison. Both
recorded in this feature's bugs.md as bug-001 and bug-002; neither was touched.
- bug-001: api-reference/creditbasedproduct/customerbalance.mdx:41 Sandbox URL is missing the `=`
  after `customerId` (`?customerId{customerID}`); the Production entry at :37 is correct.
- bug-002: api-reference/creditbasedproduct/paginatecustomercredithistory.mdx Endpoint block omits
  the path-parameter placeholder entirely (`/paginate-credit-history/?productId=...`), contradicting
  its own curl example and its usagebasedmembership sibling.

### GOTCHA for future agents — `jonggrang bug` is broken in this repo
`jonggrang bug "..." --feature <id>` ALWAYS fails with "Multiple features found. Use --feature
<featureId>." no matter where the flag is placed, and `jonggrang bug --help` fails the same way.
Root cause, confirmed by reading the CLI source: the GLOBAL option parser at
/usr/lib/node_modules/jonggrang/bin/jonggrang.js:5191 matches `--feature` first and consumes it
into WORK_FEATURE_ID, so it is stripped before `cmdBug` runs; `cmdBug`'s own lookup
(`subArgs.indexOf('--feature')`, ~line 2400) then finds nothing and `forcedFeatureId` stays null.
With more than one feature under .jonggrang/.output/features/ and non-TTY stdin, the command
cannot succeed. `--feature=<id>` does not work either (the switch matches the bare token only).
Workaround used here, and previously by the v2-coupon-list-doc feature: append the entry to
.jonggrang/.output/features/<feature>/bugs.md by hand in the CLI's format
(`## [open] bug-00N · <date> · found during <task>`).

scoped; nothing outstanding for a follow-up task.

reachable from this worktree. Project memory records it at "/root/.jonggrang/workspace/Mayar
Source"; that path does not exist here.
